notes.title: Updated Player Ratings!
notes.content: [p]Player ratings have been updated to work with the new game engine!  Since I upgraded the engine to make franchise and the on-field tactics deeper, I also had to drastically increase the number of player ratings.  Most of these ratings should be self-explanatory, but the "[b]Play Style Tendencies[/b]" section may need more detail.[/p][p][/p][p]At the start of each play, everyone will run a little bit to start the play.  Think of this as setting the chessboard for the turn-based play.  Once everyone completes the initial movement, you start the turn-based part.  Each player's initial movement is determined by the "Play Style Tendencies" ratings.  For example, if you have a QB that is maxed on Roll Out, he'll often start each play by rolling out instead of standing in the pocket.  If your LBs tend to have high Blitz, they will rush the QB on more plays than dropping back into coverage.[/p][p][/p][p]As you can see, this adds another element to roster building as well as tactical gameplay.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more feature updates as development continues![/p][p][/p][p][b]Note:  Logos and player info are just for example purposes.[/b]  (You know what I mean  :) )[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802312/55053691c9cc84e2d2ae5ce086ecb06229608140.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: We're BACK!
